notes: DiscoFlate v3.20.0 — Competitions: multiplayer roll-off / race / raffle events. Players !enter, compete during a window, winner gets their total fired + an optional winner-only command that can freeze everyone else's progression until used (with a new 'fire until capacity%' mode). Plus: [!command] fires a command from inside any message; [winner]/[winner_score]/[pump_msg] placeholders.
